questions.question: Which database backs the session store?
questions.context: Single-node deployment; existing ops tooling is Postgres-only.

options.label: Postgres
options.entails: reuse existing ops tooling, one more schema to migrate

options.label: SQLite
options.entails: zero ops, file-backed, no concurrent writers

rulesConsidered.name: prefer-boring-tech
rulesConsidered.disposition: set aside: names languages, not datastores

answer.freeText: DuckDB, we already embed it elsewhere
